assets.prompt: A single high-pitched undead humanoid scream: AAAAAH-AH! Furious, feral, shrill and throaty, with a sharp nasal rasp, strained vocal cords and sudden cracking pitch. An aggressive male horror creature vocal performance, almost a shriek. One short attack followed by a ragged two-second sustain and abrupt breathy cutoff. Dry isolated close microphone sound for a survival horror game. No words, no laughter, no music, no ambience, no reverb.
assets.selection: First variation exported for comparison; not ranked by listening.

assets.prompt: An enraged zombie gives a strained high-register scream: RRAAAAH-AAAH! Male humanoid creature with a dry saw-like rasp and shredded throaty texture. Forceful open AH vowels, rising pitch, two abrupt vocal cracks, then a breathless snarl. Frantic and hostile, like an angry horror character yelling at full force. One isolated three-second game sound. No speech, laughter, music, ambience or echo.
assets.selection: First variation exported for comparison; not ranked by listening.

assets.prompt: One demonic undead creature screams a wordless RAAAAH! A piercing high male shriek dominates, with coarse rasp, cracking pitch and wild aggression. A much quieter guttural growl follows the same vocal shape underneath, adding weight while keeping the high scream in front. Explosive onset, wavering vowel, ragged cutoff. One isolated three-second horror game vocal. Dry recording. No words, laughter, music, impacts, ambience or reverb.
